system.description:
• Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage while you are Raging.
  • If both attacks hit one creature no more than one size larger than you, it makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or, on its next turn, it can move or act, not both; standing up from Prone counts as moving.

activities.name: Savage Swing
activities.text: One additional weapon attack as part of your attack action, with Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels. If both hit one creature no more than one size larger than you, it makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or, on its next turn, it can move or act, not both (standing up from Prone counts as moving).

activities.name: Savage Swing (while Raging)
activities.text: No Disadvantage on the extra attack (while Raging). If both hit one creature no more than one size larger than you, it makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or, on its next turn, it can move or act, not both (standing up from Prone counts as moving).
